answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities. Each new identity pays a non-refundable 40 POA tax into a locked vault for 20 epochs of work, so capital cannot be recycled. A comet burst of 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA up front, while the delta between one honest agent's single tax and an attacker's thousandfold bill grows per batch. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards; rented reputation cannot dodge the tax, as it is tied to the identity.
